column3: With respect to the 50 West 23rd Street Mortgage Loan (9.0%), the borrower sponsor and non-recourse carveout guarantor were involved in the acquisition of an office property in Texas that was financed by a mortgage loan that was subsequently securitized. Following a major tenant’s decision to not renew its lease in 2016, the mortgage loan was transferred to special servicing. The mortgage loan was restructured and ultimately paid off with a 24% loss severity to the securitization trust.
